notes:
Main nav (drawer menu on every page) has a top-level 'Outlet' item -> /collections/outlet-1 (ProductCount=147). Its own on-page description reads: 'Each season, we make a special effort to create new, beautiful designs for your home. To make room for them, we must say goodbye to selected products. That's why you can now purchase our outgoing designs at especially good prices. The offer is valid while stocks last.' -- a clear permanent-markdown/outgoing-designs framing, not a temporary percent-off campaign, so recorded as clean Clearance with no flag. The Danish nav/alias URL /collections/sidste-chance ('Last Chance') 301-redirects through /collections/outlet to /collections/outlet-1 -- confirmed to be the SAME listing (an alias), so not recorded as a separate row. Sitemap enumeration (sitemap_collections_1.xml) surfaced a second, nav-unlinked clearance-shaped structure: 'Archive Sale' (/collections/archive-sale, ProductCount=93, title 'Archive Sale') with four category-specific children also only discoverable via sitemap: archive-sale-accessories (22), archive-sale-belysning='Lighting' in Danish (9), archive-sale-bordaekning-og-koekken='Table Setting & Kitchen' in Danish (37), archive-sale-moebler='Furniture' in Danish (25) -- these sum EXACTLY to 22+9+37+25=93, confirming they are the real category partition of the Archive Sale parent. No custom on-page description was set for these (og:description falls back to the site default tagline), but the name 'Archive' itself is a strong permanence/discontinued-stock signal (distinct from a temporary 'Sale'), and the product count (93) is materially different from Outlet's (147), so this was kept as a second, genuinely distinct Clearance-type listing rather than merged into Outlet. Recorded without an ambiguity flag given the strong 'Archive' signal, but noting it is currently NOT linked from main nav (sitemap-only discovery) for reviewer awareness. Also found via sitemap: 'Mid Season Sale' (/collections/mid-season-sale, ProductCount=74, title 'Mid Season Sale'), also unlinked from main nav. Its on-page description: 'Save up to 80% Refresh your home with a wide selection of discontinued designs. Offer valid until 5 May and cannot be combined with other discounts. Limited stock.' This mixes a genuine permanence signal ('discontinued designs') with clear temporary-campaign signals (date-bound 'valid until 5 May', percent-off framing, 'Limited stock') -- the textbook Sale-vs-Clearance ambiguity the brief calls out, so it is recorded WITH a manual-review flag rather than silently included or excluded. Checked English and Danish target terms (Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line/Restlager/Udsalg) across main nav, footer, drawer menu, and the full collections sitemap; no other clearance-shaped candidates found. No login/trade wall encountered; direct HTTP fetch worked for every URL (tier 1 sufficient throughout).

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 1 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
